description: This file defines the CacheInterface in the Twig templating engine, specifying methods that cache classes should implement for generating keys, writing, loading, and retrieving timestamps of cached templates.

classes.name: Twig\Cache\CacheInterface
classes.description: Interface for cache classes in Twig, outlining methods for key generation, cache writing, template loading, and timestamp retrieval.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on the template class name.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores the compiled template content in cache under a specific key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a template from cache given its key.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the modification timestamp of a cache entry identified by the key.
